title: Arquiteto de Infraestrutura (Plataforma Mainframe)
description:
Procuramos Analista de Suporte Mainframe SR que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Modalidade de Trabalho: Atuação em formato Presencial em São Paulo ou Brasília, de 23:00 às 07:00 (Segunda/Sexta).


Perfil que Buscamos:

- Pessoa Responsável por gerar e customização do sistema operacional em suporte, desenvolvimento, homologação e produção (MVS/ESA OS/390 e Z/OS).

- Instalação de sistema operacional e softwares de apoio ao Z/OS com o uso de SMP/E e Suporte a produtos de apoio a equipes de produção, desenvolvimento e produção.


Nesta função você irá:

- Coletar e analisar informações para desenvolvimento e alteração de sistemas.

- Planejar e implantar expansões de hardware I/O usando a ferramenta HCD - Hardware Configuration Definition.

- Planejar e implementar novas Lpares no complexo operacional.

- Estudo, planejamento e implementação de software voltado ao gerenciamento de Storage.

- Participação do grupo de estudo e implementação do DFSMSHSM em ambiente de suporte, desenvolvimento e produção.

- Definição de catalogos ICF CATALOG, bem como definição e manutenção de aliases e reorganização de catalogos com e sem a ferramenta TACM.

- Analisar performance do ambiente produtivo e sugerir alterações que possam maximizar e otimizar os recursos dando suporte a equipe de performance utilizando a ferrameta MAINVIEW.

- Implantação de manutenção de CF Coupling Facility e estruturas HMC: Criar e alterar configurações de hardware e profiles de ativação de CPU.


Necessário ter:

- Formação superior completa na área de TI.

- Experiência como Analista de Suporte na plataforma Mainframe.

- Atendimento de incidentes.

- Garantir o SLA contratado, manter a disponibilidade da infraestrutura funcionando 24×7 em todos os sites.

- Atuação e customização de Sistema Operacional zOS 2.2/2.4/3.1.

- Especialista da Plataforma Mainframe.

- Domínio de software básico IBM: z/OS (RACF, WLM, OMVS, JES3, TCPIP, VTAM, DFSMS, DFHSM e SMP/E).

- Domínio do software EOS ENTERPRISE OUTPUT SOLUTION, Gerenciador de Relatórios.

- Domínio do software GFS/AFM, Gerenciador de Fitoteca.

- Domínio do software GFS/BETA zSecurity, administrador de RACF.

- Programação em linguagens: Assembler, REXX e JCL.

- Coleta e monitoramento pelo software BMC Mainview.

- Noções básicas de Bancos de Dados DB2 e IMS/DB.

- Noções básicas de arquitetura de rede TCP/IP.


O que você pode esperar de nós

- Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.


O que oferecemos?

SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.E muito mais!

Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

title: Estágio Direito
description:
Descrição da Empresa  

A Compliance for Business é uma consultoria referência em Governança Corporativa, atuando em áreas como Compliance, LGPD, DPO Externo, Canal de Denúncias, Investigações Corporativas e Treinamentos. Ajudamos empresas a estarem em conformidade com as mais rigorosas leis e regulamentos, garantindo a segurança jurídica e de dados dos nossos clientes. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais apaixonados por transformar o mundo corporativo e educar nossos clientes sobre melhores práticas de governança, compliance e privacidade.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Organização e acompanhamento de cronogramas de projetos, acompanhando as fases dos projetos em andamento, garantindo que os prazos sejam cumpridos.
  • Análise e revisão de contratos de clientes e parceiros, com foco em conformidade com a LGPD e demais normas de compliance.
  • Auxílio na elaboração de Políticas, termos de uso e outros documentos essenciais para empresas.
  • Apoio nas auditorias, coletando dados e realizando análises jurídicas sobre a adequação de processos.
  • Pesquisa e análise de regulamentações, mantendo-se atualizado sobre as melhores práticas e mudanças legislativas, especialmente relacionadas à LGPD e Compliance.
  • Auxílio no atendimento ao cliente, esclarecendo dúvidas jurídicas e fornecendo suporte técnico em documentos e processos.


Qualificações

  • Cursando Direito (3º ou 4º ano).
  • Habilidade organizacional para acompanhar e manter o controle de cronogramas e prazos dos projetos.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes, com capacidade de trabalhar em múltiplas tarefas.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e oral, capaz de redigir relatórios e documentos jurídicos claros e objetivos.


Conhecimentos

  • Pacote Office Intermediário (Excel e Word);
  • Familiaridade com software de gestão de tarefas;
  • Conhecimento básico em contratos, regulamentações de privacidade e compliance regulatório será um diferencial.


O que oferecemos:

  • Regime 100% home-office
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento em um campo dinâmico e em crescimento, com muito aprendizado na área de Governança Corporativa. 
  • Mentoria contínua de profissionais da área jurídica e de compliance.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico, com participação ativa em projetos desafiadores.
  • Bolsa-auxílio compatível com o mercado, além de benefícios.

Sobre a Oportunidade


Você é apaixonado pelo mercado financeiro e busca um ambiente onde sua autonomia e capacidade de prospecção sejam os motores do seu crescimento?

Na Fincapital - BTG Pactual , estamos expandindo nosso time de talentos. Buscamos profissionais que desejam construir sua própria história e carteira de clientes, contando com o suporte de uma marca líder e uma liderança altamente qualificada.


Aqui, acreditamos que a proximidade com o cliente e a transparência são os pilares de um relacionamento duradouro. Por isso, trabalhamos com uma visão 100% pró-cliente .



O que oferecemos:


  • Modelo 100% Remoto: Trabalhe de onde estiver, com mais autonomia para gerir sua agenda.
  • Apoio de Especialistas: Você terá acesso a líderes experientes no mercado para auxiliar no seu desenvolvimento técnico e comercial.
  • Ecossistema BTG Pactual: Toda a infraestrutura e credibilidade do maior banco de investimentos da América Latina.
  • Geração de Leads: Além da sua prospecção ativa, o escritório possui estratégias para fornecimento de leads adicionais para acelerar seu crescimento.
  • Cultura Empreendedora: Liberdade para construir sua própria carteira com foco total no sucesso do investidor.
  • Apoio financeiro: Bolsa com modelo de mínimo garantido nos primeiros meses, para dar mais tranquilidade na fase de montagem de carteira.



O que buscamos em você:


  • Perfil Hunter: Energia e resiliência para prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado.
  • Visão empreendedora: Desejo de gerir o próprio negócio e crescer sem limites de remuneração.
  • Foco no Cliente: Habilidade para construir relacionamentos de confiança e entender as necessidades reais dos investidores.
  • Certificação: Necessário possuir (ou estar em processo final para) a certificação ANCORD.


Etapas de Seleção


  • Entrevista com o Recrutamento e Seleção;
  • Entrevista com Sócios;
  • Processo de Compliance.

title: Technical Support Consultant L3
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Technical Support Consultant with 3 to 5 years of software support experience to join the client operations team of our U.S. client. You will play a critical role in ensuring our client's software lives up to its world-class reputation.

Our client provides a cloud-based, ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver Level 3 customer support for our client's industry-leading software products
  • Triage reported, end-user customer incidents
  • Work technical issues and support the direct client feedback loop process
  • Help secure existing revenue by means of customer retention
  • Provide incident queue management
  • Utilize troubleshooting skills
  • Help manage complex issues and drive escalations to resolution
  • Build and demonstrate cross-application knowledge among the client's core application modules
  • Push the client's software to the limit, making sure it is efficient, intuitive, and best-in-class
  • Gain experience in the oil and gas industry; including economic, accounting, and finance knowledge


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • 3 to 5 years of Level 3 software support experience
  • Basic to intermediate SQL skills
  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite
  • A drive to continue learning in the energy business and the client's software
  • Advanced problem-solving skills
  • Ability to triage and actively manage a support queue
  • Innate passion for customer service
  • Dependability and ability to manage as well as prioritize concurrent tasks
  • Must be available for an on-call rotation
  • Ability to work U.S. CST business hours
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience creating manuals, training documentation, and interactive training materials for software applications
  • Experience providing software support and troubleshooting for SaaS applications
  • Experience in reproducing issues in a test environment prior to production deployment
  • Experience in the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Backend Developer (Python, SDK)
description:
About Us


We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


This is a full-time remote role for a Senior Backend Developer in Brazil. You will join one of our North American client's engineering team to maintain, design, implement, test, and deploy new features in their Python SDK as well as fix bugs, improve, and update its existing functionalities. As an experienced developer, you will be responsible for writing great documentation, doing demos, and mentoring others. You will participate in the client's team ceremonies and other sessions.


Must Have Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • Experience working independently and remotely.
  • Strong experience with Python.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with Public API and Python SDK on the backend implementation side.
  • Familiarity with FastAPI is a plus since one of the tasks ahead is to tighten up the client endpoints so that the developer generates well-designed and comprehensive OpenAPI specifications.
  • SDK coding for other developers


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.

description:
About Us:

Carepod is a premium humidifier brand operating in the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re growing fast and building a data-driven culture where insights actually shape decisions.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst who thinks like a business partner, not just a report builder.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain dashboards & projection tools such as sales, marketing, inventory, etc.
  • Analyze ecommerce & marketing data (Shopify, ads, reviews)
  • Identify trends in conversion, retention, and customer behavior
  • Support leadership with clear insights and recommendations

  • 3+ years experience as a Data Analyst
  • Strong SQL + Excel / Google Sheets
  • Experience with dashboards & KPIs
  • Exeprience with AI Automations such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, n8n, Make, Airtable, etc.
  • Ecommerce or DTC experience preferred
  • Comfortable communicating insights in English
  • Bonus: Python, BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)


Why Carepod

  • Direct exposure to leadership
  • Real impact on decisions
  • International business experience
  • Fully remote, long-term opportunity


What We Offer:

 • Fully remote work environment

 • Competitive salary

 • Flexible PTO policy

 • Opportunity to grow with a scaling e-commerce brand

 • A supportive, collaborative, and agile team culture


⸻


To Apply:

  • Send your resume and a short note about why you’re a great fit

Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Phyton Sr.

Sobre a Motivus


Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Python
  • Atuação em projetos utilizando Flask e FastAPI

  • Experiência com banco de dados SQL Server, incluindo modelagem e consultas

Desejável:

  • Familiaridade com APIs REST
  • Experiência em ambientes colaborativos e metodologias ágeis



Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Salesforce
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and implement scalable Salesforce solutions using Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Lightning Components.


  • Customize Salesforce objects, workflows, validation rules, and approval processes.


  • Develop Apex classes, triggers, Visualforce pages, Lightning Web Components (LWC).


  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs.


  • Perform data migration and ensure data integrity.


  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.


  • Conduct unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning.


  • Stay updated with Salesforce releases and best practices.


Required Skills:


  • Strong experience in Apex, Visualforce, LWC, SOQL, SOSL.


  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce configuration and customization.


  • Knowledge of Salesforce security model, sharing rules, and governor limits.


  • Experience with Salesforce integrations (API, middleware tools like MuleSoft).


  • Familiarity with Salesforce deployment tools (Change Sets, ANT, SFDX).


  • Good understanding of Agile methodology.

Indústria : TI & Serviços


Esta posição exige habilidades avançadas de comunicação em inglês, tanto escrita quanto verbal.


Lead Software Engineer | Sobre Você

Como Lead Software Engineer, você é responsável por impulsionar a visão técnica por trás de aplicações modernas e escaláveis, enquanto orienta uma equipe de engenharia de alta performance. Você prospera na interseção entre arquitetura, desenvolvimento prático e mentoria, equilibrando decisões estratégicas com a paixão por construir software de excelência.

Você gosta de definir padrões de engenharia, elevar as capacidades da equipe e tomar decisões conscientes que influenciam o sucesso do produto a longo prazo.

É motivado(a) por resolver desafios técnicos complexos e criar ambientes onde os engenheiros possam realizar o seu melhor trabalho.


Lead Software Engineer | Atividades do Dia a Dia

  • Liderar o design e desenvolvimento de aplicações complexas e escaláveis usando .NET e frameworks modernos de JavaScript, como Angular ou React.
  • Definir padrões de engenharia, melhores práticas e diretrizes arquiteturais para a equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Arquitetar e manter sistemas na nuvem seguros, de alta disponibilidade e otimizados para desempenho.
  • Colaborar com equipes de Produto, QA e DevOps para garantir alinhamento entre as soluções técnicas e os objetivos de negócio.
  • Orientar engenheiros, promovendo aprendizado contínuo, qualidade na execução e compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Realizar revisões de código para garantir aderência aos padrões de qualidade, segurança e manutenibilidade.
  • Resolver desafios técnicos avançados e influenciar decisões relacionadas à arquitetura e seleção de tecnologias.


Lead Software Engineer | Habilidades & Experiência

  • 7+ anos de experiência em engenharia de software, com proficiência avançada em .NET e frameworks modernos de JavaScript (Angular ou React).
  • Experiência comprovada liderando equipes de engenharia e colaborando efetivamente entre diferentes áreas.
  • Forte expertise em TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 e padrões modernos de desenvolvimento web.
  • Experiência prática no deploy e otimização de aplicações na AWS ou outras grandes plataformas de nuvem.
  • Conhecimento profundo de arquitetura de sistemas, padrões de design e princípios de aplicações escaláveis.
  • Excelentes habilidades de liderança e comunicação em inglês, tanto escrita quanto verbal.

  • 7+ anos de experiência em engenharia de software, com proficiência avançada em .NET e frameworks modernos de JavaScript (Angular ou React).
  • Experiência comprovada liderando equipes de engenharia e colaborando efetivamente entre diferentes áreas.
  • Forte expertise em TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 e padrões modernos de desenvolvimento web.
  • Experiência prática no deploy e otimização de aplicações na AWS ou outras grandes plataformas de nuvem.
  • Conhecimento profundo de arquitetura de sistemas, padrões de design e princípios de aplicações escaláveis.
  • Excelentes habilidades de liderança e comunicação em inglês, tanto escrita quanto verbal.

title: AWS Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções de Ciência de Dados e IA Generativa, com foco em arquiteturas RAG;
  • Executar demandas priorizadas pelo Product Owner, realizando detalhamento técnico e definição de abordagens de Machine Learning e GenAI;
  • Desenvolver, sustentar e monitorar pipelines de dados, modelos de ML, APIs e fluxos de IA;
  • Validar performance de sistemas RAG;
  • Implementar pipelines de ingestão e indexação de textos em bancos vetoriais;
  • Construir APIs e fluxos utilizando LangChain, LangGraph e integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações conteinerizadas e arquiteturas serverless em AWS e Azure;
  • Produzir visualizações e indicadores para análise crítica e validação de resultados;
  • Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura, segurança, escalabilidade e boas práticas em nuvem.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Python e bibliotecas Pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow e PyTorch;
  • Experiência prática com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs), soluções de IA Generativa e arquiteturas RAG;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de avaliação de NLP e IA (similaridade semântica, BLEU, ROUGE);
  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem AWS, incluindo os serviços: S3, Lambda, RDS, SageMaker, Parameter Store e Secret Manager;
  • Desenvolvimento de pipelines em bancos vetoriais (AWS OpenSearch);
  • Construção de APIs utilizando LangChain e LangGraph;
  • Integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Uso de Azure Document Intelligence para processamento de documentos.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em DevOps aplicado a ML/IA (MLOps).

title: Analytics Engineer - Especialista I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos, resilientes e de referência técnica para a tribo;
  • Atua como referência na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
  • Lidera iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Realiza análises críticas do que está sendo desenvolvido, avaliando impacto, qualidade e reuso por outros times, tanto do ponto de vista de dados quanto de negócio;
  • Propõe e implementa melhorias contínuas em processos de dados, orquestrando stakeholders e fomentando boas práticas que elevem o nível de maturidade analítica da organização;
  • Atua como mentor(a) e referência técnica para analistas de outros níveis, disseminando conhecimento e boas práticas.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em programação (preferencialmente Python), com aplicação prática em automação, análise avançada e engenharia de dados
  • Domínio em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), com experiência comprovada em ambientes complexos e de grande escala;
  • Excelência em SQL, capaz de desenvolver consultas altamente otimizadas e escaláveis;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
  • Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;
  • Capacidade comprovada de liderar projetos cross-times, influenciar decisões estratégicas e atuar como ponto focal técnico em fóruns executivos e de negócio.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer

£70,000 - £90,000

Remote - Brazil (You will need to work UK time zone)


You already know how to build software that works.


What you might be missing is the chance to build something that matters, where the details count and the users notice when you get it right.


This role is for an engineer who cares how things look, how they behave, and how they hold up when real money and real users are involved.


Why you’ll love it here:

  • You’ll own real parts of the product, not just tickets
  • The UI has to be precise and trusted, not “close enough”
  • You’ll work across the full stack with real influence over decisions
  • The product sits between traditional finance expectations and onchain systems
  • You’ll build for institutional and high net worth users who demand clarity and reliability


Who this isn’t for:

This isn’t a role for someone who wants a narrow remit, loose UI standards, or to ship features without thinking end to end.


If you prefer clear tickets, minimal ownership, or letting AI do the thinking for you, this will feel uncomfortable.


Day to day:

You’ll be building and refining a production platform used to manage onchain assets.


That means turning product direction and designs into polished, accurate UI, then wiring it properly into APIs, databases, and background workflows.


The split is genuinely full stack. You’ll spend meaningful time on the frontend, but you’re also expected to contribute confidently on the backend so features are built end to end, not in isolation.


Performance, maintainability, and correctness matter because this platform is already live and evolving.


The Business:

title: Engenheiro de Dados Especialista
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Liderar a definição técnica e a evolução da estratégia de Data Lake, garantindo uma arquitetura robusta e escalável;
  • Desenhar e estruturar camadas de dados (Raw, Trusted, Refined) e fluxos de processamento baseados em padrões de ETL e ELT;
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;
  • Desenvolver e automatizar pipelines de dados complexos, garantindo a entrega eficiente para modelos preditivos e análises avançadas;
  • Otimizar continuamente o desempenho dos fluxos de dados, reduzindo latência e custos operacionais de processamento;
  • Implementar ferramentas e práticas que permitam a escalabilidade da modelagem de dados voltada à decisão estratégica;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida da aquisição de dados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para os stakeholders;
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo processos de monitoramento e validação;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e as áreas de negócio, garantindo que as soluções de dados estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Tecnologia.
  • Sólida experiência em pipelines e Big Data (Python/Java/Scala);
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes e metodologias ágeis;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Perfil autônomo, analítico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.


Nossos benefícios:


O Que Temos Para Você

title: Analista Desenvolvedor Fullstack
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Estamos buscando um profissional com:


Backend e Persistência de Dados

* Sólida experiência com EJB (Enterprise JavaBeans) e JPA (Java Persistence API).

* Atuação com bancos de dados relacionais, incluindo modelagem, otimização de consultas e manipulação avançada de dados.

* Desenvolvimento de queries nativas para bancos relacionais.

Arquitetura e Boas Práticas

* Aplicação de design patterns e boas práticas voltadas a arquiteturas escaláveis, performáticas e sustentáveis.

Integrações e Mensageria

* Experiência com filas JMS.

* Desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs REST, com foco em desempenho, segurança e padronização.

Infraestrutura e DevOps

* Experiência com servidores de aplicação IBM WebSphere.

* Utilização de Maven para gerenciamento de dependências e build.

* Controle de versão utilizando Git.

Qualidade e Monitoramento

* Forte experiência na criação e manutenção de testes unitários, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e manutenibilidade do código.

* Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise e monitoramento de logs, com preferência por Graylog.

Frontend e Desenvolvimento Web

* Conhecimento em Angular 2+ e arquitetura de Microfrontend, para construção de aplicações modulares e escaláveis.


Benefícios que oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

description:

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients.   • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional experience in C# and Angular or React.js to support the development, migration, and ongoing evolution of a platform. This role will play a key part in delivering new product initiatives, maintaining existing systems, and implementing a modernized architecture across multiple verticals.

The ideal candidate is technically strong across the stack, comfortable working within an established architectural vision, and proactive in taking ownership of implementation and delivery.


Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI powering solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain full-stack features across web applications and backend services
  • Implement solutions aligned with architectural guidance provided by the architecture team
  • Contribute to the development of new products while maintaining and enhancing existing systems
  • Support the migration of legacy components into a modern microservices-based architecture
  • Build and maintain scalable backend services using C# , .NET , and SQL
  • Develop and maintain front-end functionality using Angular , with the
  • ability to quickly learn and adapt as needed
  • Collaborate across multiple product verticals and support a growing pipeline of new initiatives
  • Take technical ownership of assigned areas, leading implementation efforts and driving work forward
  • Partner closely with Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams to deliver on the broader technical vision


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience as a software engineer in a full-stack capacity
  • Strong backend experience with C# , .NET , and SQL
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining microservices-based systems
  • Front-end development experience, ideally with Angular , or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Experience working within an established architecture and implementing designs created by an architecture team
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work across multiple projects and verticals
  • Proactive, energetic mindset with a willingness to take ownership and lead by example


Preferred Experience

  • Experience participating in large-scale system migrations or platform modernization efforts
  • Exposure to cloud-based environments and distributed systems
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments with multiple concurrent initiatives


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·        Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·        5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·        Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·        Brazil-based ( fully remote )

·        Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·        Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·        Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·        High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·        Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings

Submit your CV  in English , and  one paragraph  describing how you would approach the  first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Júnior – Java & Angular
description:
A Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com 112 mil colaboradores em 73 países e receita anual de €12 bilhões. Há mais de 30 anos no Brasil conectando pessoas, negócios e tecnologia para ajudar a melhorar o mundo em que vivemos.


Sobre a Vaga


Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office

Contratação: CLT

Prazo: Indeterminado

Horário: Comercial


Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Júnior para atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas corporativos, com foco em aprendizado contínuo e evolução técnica.

A pessoa atuará em conjunto com profissionais mais experientes, participando do desenvolvimento de soluções integradas a ERPs, sistemas fiscais e órgãos públicos, com exposição a ambientes de Big Data e aplicações de missão crítica.


Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento back-end em Java e Ruby , com acompanhamento do time.
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento front-end utilizando Angular 7 .
  • Auxiliar na manutenção e consultas em bancos de dados PostgreSQL e Vertica (Big Data) .
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs para integração com sistemas ERP (SAP) .
  • Apoiar em integrações com sistemas fiscais e órgãos públicos (Prefeituras e SEFAZ).
  • Atuar na correção de bugs, melhorias evolutivas e suporte aos sistemas.
  • Seguir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento e documentação.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Conhecimentos em Java .
  • Noções de Angular 7 .
  • Conhecimento básico em PostgreSQL .
  • Noções de Ruby .
  • Conhecimento básico em integração via APIs .
  • Interesse em aprender sobre sistemas fiscais , SAP e integrações governamentais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência acadêmica ou profissional com Big Data / Vertica .
  • Conhecimento prévio em sistemas fiscais (NF-e, NFS-e, SEFAZ).
  • Vivência com projetos integrados a ERP SAP .

title: Investment Manager (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with Investment decision makers such as Investment Manager, Portfolio Manager, Financial Advisor or Analyst who are working in investment bank, private equity firms, asset management firms or family offices.



Qualifications:

  • The purpose of this study is to gain an understanding of the global awareness of city’s attractiveness in trade, investment and partnership. I believe your opinions and expertise would be valuable for our study and I wonder if you’re interested in taking part.
  • Job titles: Head of Investment, Portfolio Manager or Investment Manager, Wealth Manager, Wealth Advisor, Analyst.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 30-minute interview conducted via MS Teams and the interview can be held in either English or Portuguese.
  • Please note that, before the final interview, there'll be a 10-minute quick online screener to share more details on the research and to check that this is relevant to you.


Compensation package - BRL 1100 for a 30-minute online interview.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
About Growave

Growave is a Shopify retention platform that helps brands grow through Loyalty & Rewards, Referrals, Wishlist, Reviews, and Instagram UGC. Thousands of merchants worldwide use Growave, including Lego, Crocs, Dermalogica, Unilever, Sony, and Aldo.


The Role

We’re looking for a Technical Support Specialist to help Shopify merchants get the most out of Growave. You’ll troubleshoot technical issues, customize Shopify themes, and work closely with Product and Engineering teams to deliver smooth solutions.


Employment Type

Contractor (Contract) – you are responsible for your own taxes and social contributions.


Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot technical issues on Shopify storefronts
  • Customize Shopify themes (Liquid) for Growave widgets and integrations
  • Communicate with clients via Intercom, email, and calls
  • Create and edit scripts for Reviews, Loyalty, and Wishlist features
  • Debug client-side issues using browser developer tools
  • Collaborate with Developers on complex technical cases
  • Read and modify code in Shopify + Growave environment


Requirements

  • 1+ year of experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Shopify theme customization experience (Liquid)
  • Familiarity with Shopify apps and ecosystem
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication and self-management skills


Languages

  • English and Portuguese (required )
  • Additional languages are a plus


What We Offer

  • Fully remote work
  • Paid vacation and public holidays in your country
  • Work on a fast-growing global Shopify product
  • Collaboration with an experienced international team

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
About Us

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


About Your Team

At Teachable, our Data team aims to support company data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Data, you will collaborate with business and product teams to validate hypotheses, answer complex business questions, help the company in uncertain scenarios, perform data experiments, and disseminate actionable insights.


About You

You will take the lead in exploring data and cross-business variables, uncovering patterns and trends, identifying new data sources, and delivering valuable insights to various departments.


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute complex data analyses using statistical techniques and modeling to validate business hypotheses.
  • Detect patterns, trends and anomalies in data and translate them into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and business growth.
  • Serve as a key expert in data analysis, providing guidance and best practices to team members and stakeholders across the company.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.
  • Strong curiosity for uncovering insights from data.
  • Proven experience in delivering data studies focused on generating and sharing actionable data.
  • Deep understanding of statistical methods, including hypothesis testing and statistical modeling.
  • Proficiency in SQL for extracting data directly from source systems.
  • Sharp critical thinking and analytical problem-solving abilities.
  • Enjoy working in a dynamic environment with fast learning and deliveries.
  • Advanced English proficiency (conversational, listening, writing.)


Nice to Have:

  • Ability to perform data cleaning and processing steps using Python or R languages.
  • Hands-on experience in building Machine Learning models.


This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


About Your Team

At Teachable, our Data team aims to support company data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Data, you will collaborate with business and product teams to validate hypotheses, answer complex business questions, help the company in uncertain scenarios, perform data experiments, and disseminate actionable insights.


About You

You will take the lead in exploring data and cross-business variables, uncovering patterns and trends, identifying new data sources, and delivering valuable insights to various departments.


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute complex data analyses using statistical techniques and modeling to validate business hypotheses.
  • Detect patterns, trends and anomalies in data and translate them into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and business growth.
  • Serve as a key expert in data analysis, providing guidance and best practices to team members and stakeholders across the company.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.
  • Strong curiosity for uncovering insights from data.
  • Proven experience in delivering data studies focused on generating and sharing actionable data.
  • Deep understanding of statistical methods, including hypothesis testing and statistical modeling.
  • Proficiency in SQL for extracting data directly from source systems.
  • Sharp critical thinking and analytical problem-solving abilities.
  • Enjoy working in a dynamic environment with fast learning and deliveries.
  • Advanced English proficiency (conversational, listening, writing.)


Nice to Have:

  • Ability to perform data cleaning and processing steps using Python or R languages.
  • Hands-on experience in building Machine Learning models.


This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: EOS Linux Server Manager (Inglês Avançado)
description:
LINUX SERVER MANAGER FOR ENHANCED OPERATIONS SERVICE


We are looking for professionals with extensive experience in Linux and Unix, and public Cloud, for support in Professional Services.

The ideal candidate has deep understanding of Cloud operations, being able to give L3 support, acting in a big team, dedicated to help clients. We need someone able to solve critical and high-impact issues independently.

A customer first mindset is a must.


• Participate in Major incident handling, troubleshoot service request failures, downtime extensions, long running ongoing incidents for a customer. (Level 3 support)

• Quick responses during escalations, take proactive steps to avoid escalations, identifying and driving initiatives to improve the operation and stability for our customer system

• Drive initiatives to standardize and simplify server operations.

• Continuous improvement methodologies: root cause analysis for Service requests failures/outages, performance issues

• Analyze root-causes of the failures (if known) in achieving the KPIS and define a corrective action plan, with well-defined mitigation steps.

• Coordinate and orchestrate the work between the various teams, collaborating with other units within and outside Enterprise Cloud Service units.

• Process improvement initiatives for daily operational activities

• Streamline standard operating procedures by focusing on automation enhancements.

• Proactive Operation services for the customer and service on-demand with timely alert reduction program to all the stakeholders involving the customer.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Technically skilled in providing expert support for all Linux OS/Windows and Infra customer issues (Expert Linux Administrator).

• Strong experience in administration of our cloud platform based on Linux operating systems in Azure, AWS and Google Cloud as well as in SAP data centres.

• Pacemaker administration knowledge.

• Practical experience with OS operation, upgrades and security patching

• Networking experience with the suite of TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, firewalls

• Experience with network services like DNS and LDAP and HTTP proxies

• Good understanding of IT security, OS hardening

• Experience in script programming (Shell, Perl, Python, Go) and with server automation tools (Ansible, CHEF)

• Experience with server operations in large environments and in public clouds.

• Experience in Problem Management, Root cause analysis methodologies

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of related professional experience

• Bachelor’s degree or higher (Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management)

• Good analytical and solution-oriented thinking

• Very good communication

• Experience of safeguarding customer relationship and strong customer service focus

• Fluency in English



We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: 销售工程师
description:
Company Overview

Renepoly (Official Website: ) is a provider of smart microgrid and energy storage solutions in the new energy industry. Our products cover commercial & industrial energy storage and utility-scale energy storage systems, coupled with a self-developed Energy Management System (EMS). We are committed to delivering one-stop clean energy project services for governments, industrial parks, commercial complexes and new energy enterprises.


Equipped with our own manufacturing facility, we boast a solid track record of project delivery, a diversified resource network, as well as an experienced R&D and after-sales team. We have successfully implemented multiple megawatt-scale energy storage and microgrid demonstration projects, with our business scope covering smart energy management, grid peak-shaving, renewable energy grid integration and other fields.


Job Description:

1. Responsible for sales of energy products in Brazil and surrounding markets.

2. Develop new clients, maintain existing relationships, and drive order closures.

3. Manage local warehouse operations and perform basic inventory management.

4. Accompany clients to project sites/warehouse for equipment demonstrations and conduct customer visits.

5. Proactively identify potential clients and expand market share in the new energy storage sector.


Requirements:

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with 5+ years of sales experience in new energy, electrical, EPC, PV, or energy storage.

2. Background in new energy vehicles, equipment, or engineering industries.

3. Fluency in Spanish and Portuguese, and English.

4. Ability to independently develop clients and execute sales tasks with a proactive approach.

6. Experience in warehouse or inventory management is a plus.

7. Update the progress of customer follow-up weekly.

8. Hold regular business progress reporting meetings with the Director of Foreign Trade and the General Manager of the Americas every two weeks.



Join us and share the green-economy opportunity!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of back-end software development experience, a strong background in Node.js, and experience using AI code generation tools to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. Working closely with product stakeholders, you will play an integral role in building an industry-leading product.


The client is focused on greater AI-first development, so a significant part of your role will involve designing and implementing AI-driven features using AI-first development techniques. This includes leveraging prompt engineering to optimize the client's AI models and utilizing cutting-edge tools, such as Cursor and Copilot, to enable smarter development.


As a Sr. Software Engineer, your job is to work between the front-end and product teams to create, publish, and develop clean software. Youll create software that facilitates veterinarian-patient communication and reduces the burden on clinic staff! You must see the big picture of where the client is going and fill in the gaps. Do you actively integrate AI tools and techniques into your daily engineering workflow? Do you support thoughtful discussions and challenge existing ideas? Share what you know, learn what you don't.


Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded and growth-stage, comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new applications and features
  • Build and enhance advanced applications using Node.js
  • Design and implement AI-first features using LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude)
  • Integrate and leverage AI development tools like Cursor and Copilot
  • Provide estimates for features, bug fixes, upgrades, and new projects
  • Participate in clearly and concisely documenting applications and custom-built frameworks
  • Write automated unit and feature tests enabling continuous delivery of your great work
  • Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies (especially AI-related) to maximize development efficiency
  • Support other teammates through good communication and feedback during code reviews
  • See the big picture and support the client's mission of facilitating better pet care


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of engineering experience working on consumer-facing (B2C or B2B), high-volume, commercial software products and services
  • 3+ years of experience with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript (bonus)
  • Proven expertise in prompt engineering for various AI models
  • Regular use of AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, or others to streamline development is preferred
  • A curiosity to explore how you can improve your workflow using AI
  • Experience with object-oriented programming patterns
  • Experience with scaling and performance improvement
  • Knowledge of both relational and non-relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB)
  • High execution mindset while balancing the risk vs costs vs timeline
  • Proven history of delivering production-ready applications promptly
  • Experience creating and consuming API's (preferably with GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services (server setup a bonus)
  • Team player eager to learn from and mentor others
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Strong experience with AI-first development methodologies


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Unix Linux System Administrator
description:
Your role and responsibilities:


  • Lead L2/L3 production and project support for Linux environments
  • Manage installations, patching, migrations, and scripting (Shell & Perl)
  • Troubleshoot hardware/software issues across Linux, HP-UX, Solaris, and AIX
  • Optimize system performance and availability
  • Coach and mentor team members
  • Work with ITIL-based tools and monitoring systems


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Hands-on experience in Linux and Unix systems
  • Deep expertise in filesystem, volume, and storage management
  • Strong knowledge of networking, clustering (PCS), and system hardening
  • Familiarity with SAN/NAS, backup tools (TSM, VEEAM), and storage suites (EMC, NetApp, Hitachi)
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
  • Flexibility to work weekends and non-standard hours
  • Advanced English


Bonus Points:


  • Linux certification
  • German language skills
  • Experience with Veritas Cluster, Apache, DNS, DHCP, LDAP


Please submit resumé in English.

title: Android Developer (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Android development;
  • Hands-on experience with Coroutines or RxJava;
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code;
  • Experience working in collaborative development environments;
  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese;
  • Willingness to relocate from Brazil to Portugal;
  • Available to work in Porto or Lisbon (hybrid work model).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Engenheiro de Plataforma Kubernetes/Openshift Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos colaborando com uma empresa portuguesa de referência no setor do varejo , presente em Portugal e Espanha. Neste contexto, procuramos alguém com energia, responsabilidade e motivação para assumir a função de ENGENHEIRO DE PLATAFORMA KUBERNETES / OPENSHIFT , numa das iniciativas que estamos a conduzir com este cliente.

Neste projeto, a pessoa que se juntar ao time irá trabalhar remotamente com colegas da FCamara e do Cliente baseados em Portugal.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Esta pessoa terá como responsabilidade participar nos esforços de modernização da infraestrutura que suporta as aplicações de negócio do nosso Cliente.


Requisitos e qualificações

Para esta posição, procuramos alguém com pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em funções semelhantes.

Você é a pessoa certa se atender estes requisitos obrigatórios :

  • Experiência prática com tecnologias de contêiner e orquestração, como Kubernetes;
  • Familiaridade com pipelines CI/CD utilizando Github Actions ou similares e ferramentas GitOps como Argo CD;
  • Experiência com provedores de nuvem, preferencialmente Azure ou GCP;
  • Experiência no uso de stacks de monitoramento e observabilidade, como Grafana e Prometheus;
  • Experiência em práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) e ferramentas como Terraform e Crossplane;
  • Experiência em Linux, TCP/IP, serviços de rede e segurança;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe com mentalidade de produto:
  • Desenvolver serviços de infraestrutura da plataforma;
  • Projetar e implementar serviços de infraestrutura como produtos;
  • Automatizar o ciclo de desenvolvimento dos produtos de infraestrutura;
  • Certificação CKA ou Openshift (obrigatório).

Para além do conhecimento técnico, também esperamos que tenhas um perfil de colaboração e trabalho em equipe :

  • Capacidade para compreender os requisitos e as soluções técnicas
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação
  • Espírito crítico e foco na melhoria contínua
  • Forte orientação para a entrega e cumprimento de prazos e objetivos

Informações adicionais

Esta é uma posição Full Remote , atuando com equipes do Cliente baseados em Portugal e é específica para quem reside no Brasil (em qualquer cidade ou estado).

Esta posição está inserida num projeto de longa duração .

Idiomas: Nesta posição, o trabalho decorre em língua portuguesa . Inglês será valorizado, especialmente para interações em contexto internacional.

Modelo de Contratação: Temos flexibilidade no modelo de contratação. A nossa equipe de recrutamento fornecerá todos os detalhes e informações sobre o tipo de contrato, remuneração e benefícios, ajustados à tua localização e situação profissional.

Nacionalidade, Residência e Visto: Esta posição não contempla apoio, por parte da FCamara, na obtenção de visto ou autorização de residência para Portugal ou qualquer outro país.
